ض.definition: Ḍād (ﺽ), is one of the six letters the Arabic [alphabet] added to the [twenty-two] inherited from the [Phoenician alphabet] (the others being ṯāʾ, ḫāʾ, ḏāl, ẓāʾ, ġayn). In name and shape, it is a variant of ṣād . Its numerical value is 800 (see Abjad numerals).
ض.example:
ضض ضض ضضضضض ضض ضض؟

ضضضضض!

ضضضضض....................

ضضضض؟؟؟!!!!
